DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これは戦争です！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: また物騒な……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ここまで堂々と喧嘩を仕掛けてくるなら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 受けて立ちます、風紀委員会の行政官として！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: むしろ好都合ですね。この際、徹底的に叩き潰してやれば……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……何があったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 地べたに這いつくばらせて、身の程を知ってもらいましょう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ああもう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつもいつも！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 一体どうしたの……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: では先生、また後ほど！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 遅れないでください、これは戦争ですから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……ええっと、アコ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、そろそろシャーレに戻った頃でしょうか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はお付き合いいただき、ありがとうございました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 落ち着いた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何ですか、それは

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私が平常心を失っていたとでも？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつも通りでしたが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それはそうと、ドレスを決めました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どれにしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生に選んでいただいたものにしました。このドレスを扱っている店舗に連絡を入れてみたところ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっと、それって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 幸い、取り置きが可能のようでした

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気に入った物が見つかって、本当に良かったです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 明日はドレスを受け取りに行くので、遅れないようにお願いしますね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっ……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 約束、忘れてませんよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ドレスを受け取りに行きましょう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんな約束したっけ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まったく……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: つべこべ言わずに来てください、大人でしょう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えぇ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: い、急いで向かいます……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お待ちしています

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生……ドレス、届けてくださったんですね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 自分で受け取るべきところを、お手数おかけしました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございます

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度きちんとお礼をさせてください

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……あの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何ですか、これは

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 紐、みたいな物が入っているのですが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あ、アコ、それには理由があって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 下着……？いえ、どう見ても紐ですね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生が買ったんですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: た、たしかに買ったのは私だけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こんな恥ずかしい物を着ろと？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私が生意気な態度を取ったからって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 生徒にこんな格好をさせるんですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんなつもりじゃないからね！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで私が、はい分かりましたなんて言うとでも！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あり得ません！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これは返品しますから！返品です！返品！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: は、はい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あと数日でパーティー当日を迎えます

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふ、準備は整いました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この戦争、私の勝利は決まったも同然です

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 最近、特に忙しそうだったね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ですが、まだ気を抜くのは早いです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 僅かな隙もあってはなりませんから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ですので、予行演習を行います

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 予行演習って？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、急いでパーティー会場に来てください

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 特訓です！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どういうこと……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はお疲れ様でした

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: アコもお疲れ様

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの、先生……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……大切にしますね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それだけは伝えておきます

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이렇게까지 싸움을 걸어온다면 선도부의 행정관으로서 피할 수 없겠죠.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 오히려 잘됐네요. 이번 기회에 잘근잘근 밟아버릴 수 있을 테니까!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 바닥에서 저를 올려다보면서 자신들의 위치를 다시금 되새길 기회니까, 그 녀석들에게도 좋은 약이 될 거예요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 말하면 어쩐지 지금까지 진정하지 못했던 것처럼 들리는데요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 전혀 아니거든요? 완전 평정심 그 자체였거든요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그건 그렇고…… 무슨 드레스로 할지 정했어요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님이 골라주신 걸로 하기로 했어요. 이 드레스를 취급하는 곳이 이곳 한군데밖에 없어서 연락해 봤는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다행히 아직 주문 제작이 가능하다고 하더라고요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래도 다행히 제 마음에 드는 걸 찾을 수 있었던 거 같아요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아, 맞아. 내일 드레스를 사러 가야 하니까, 시간, 늦으시면 안 돼요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 끈……? 리본…… 비슷한 건…… 뭔가요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이건 속옷……? 아, 아니. 그렇게 주장하고 있을 뿐인 끈이잖아요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그건 말야. 아코. 내가 사준 건 맞는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 즉, 이런 야한 속옷을 입으라는 건가요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 평상시에 건방지니까 이런 걸 입혀서 벌주려는 건가요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런 걸 제가 순순히 따를 거라고 생각했어요?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 말도 안 되는…… 파렴치한 것도 정도가 있지, 이건 반품이에요! 반품!!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 알고 계세요! 네? 반품해 버릴 거니까요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 저는 만반의 준비를 다 끝내놓은 상태예요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후. 이대로 그 전쟁은 무사히 저의 승리로 끝나게 되겠죠.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음, 그치만 이렇게 중요한 전투를 앞두고 좀 더 치밀한 준비가 필요하다고 생각해요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 한 치의 실수도 있어서는 안 되니까요.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. It's Amau Ako.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The war has begun!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ako, are you okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! I don't care what those gremlins' reasons were.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If it's a fight they want, I, the Senior Administrator of the Prefect Team, shall oblige them!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe this is a blessing in disguise? An opportunity to stomp them into their place!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A-Ako?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It'll be a good lesson for them. They'll gaze upon me from the floor and finally understand the way things should be!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Uh, this is so frustrating! Just the thought of it

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: is maddening!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ako, what is going on?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you in a bit, Sensei!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't be late! This is a war after all!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hello?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. Did you make it back okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thanks for hanging out with me today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Have you calmed down from earlier?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hm?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What does that mean?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: When you put it like that, it sounds like I haven't been calm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That's not the case at all! I've been completely calm this whole time!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway... I've decided on which dress I'd like.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oho. Which one did you pick?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I went with the one you suggested. There's only one place that sells it though, so I contacted them.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Wait... Ako. That's...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Luckily, they're still taking custom orders.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm so glad I found one I really liked.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, that's right. We HAVE to buy the dress tomorrow. So don't be late!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Pardon?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, you promised.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's dress shopping day.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't remember making that promise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Really...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Aren't you a grown-up?! Quit complaining and come on.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: This is a nightmare...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hm?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: N-Nothing. I'll be there.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Very good, Sensei. I'll be waiting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I've received my dress.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry. I could have just gone there myself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I didn't mean to bother you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: All this debt...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hm?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's this?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What is this string? Is this a ribbon?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh that's...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is this what I think it is? U-Undies?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you buy this?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Y-Yes. Technically, I did...!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you telling me to wear this, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you trying to get back at me for being cheeky?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I can't believe this...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No! Ako, the store clerk...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm just supposed to believe a random sales clerk?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What nonsense... There are lines in the sand, Sensei! I'm returning this!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You hear me?! I said I'm returning it!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: *sigh*

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, it's almost time for the party.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My preparations are all complete.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. This war is sure to end in my favor.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Someone's in a good mood...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Am I?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm, maybe I need a little more "practice" before such a major battle.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I cannot afford to make any mistakes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They do say practice makes perfect.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Practice?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Try to get here on time, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It'll be a special "practice" session with me!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Pardon?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for all your help today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You did a great job too, Ako.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, and um...Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That clerk really was right.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: H-Huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about it!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู อามาอุ อาโกะเองค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: นี่มันสงครามเลยนะคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อาโกะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ ต้องบอกว่าอวดดี แล้วก็อภัยให้ไม่ได้ด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ามาหาเรื่องทะเลาะกันแบบนี้ เจ้าหน้าที่คณะกรรมการวินัยอย่างฉัน
ก็คงอยู่เฉยไม่ได้ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่สิ ดีเลยเสียอีกค่ะ ฉันจะใช้โอกาสนี้เหยียบพวกนั้นให้จมดินไปเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... อาโกะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่คงเป็นโอกาสที่พวกนั้นจะได้มองขึ้นมา
จากพื้นที่ตัวเองอยู่และทบทวนตำแหน่ง
ของตัวเองอีกครั้ง ดังนั้นจึงถือเป็นยาที่
ดีสำหรับพวกเขาค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โธ่เอ๊ย น่าโมโหจริงๆ!! พอมาคิดดูแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันก็ยิ่งน่าโมโห!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อาโกะ... มีเรื่องอะไร...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู เดี๋ยวเจอกันนะคะ!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ห้ามมาสายนะคะ! นี่มันสงครามเลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ฮัลโหล?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู กลับไปถึงหรือยังคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ขอบคุณที่ไปด้วยกันนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ใจเย็นลงบ้างมั้ย...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมพูดแบบนั้นล่ะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าพูดแบบนั้น จะฟังดูเหมือนวันนี้
ฉันไม่ได้สงบสติอารมณ์เลยนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ใช่อย่างนั้นสักหน่อย
ตอนนี้ฉันสุขุมมากเลยต่างหากค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เอาเถอะค่ะ... ตอนนี้ฉันเลือกได้แล้ว
ว่าจะใส่ชุดอะไร

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โอ้ เลือกชุดไหนเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะใส่ชุดที่คุณครูเลือกให้ค่ะ
มีร้านอยู่ร้านเดียวที่ขายชุดนี้
ฉันก็เลยลองติดต่อไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ... คุณอาโกะ... เรื่องนั้นน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โชคดีที่ทางนั้นบอกว่ายังสั่งตัดได้อยู่ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ยังไงก็โล่งไปทีที่สามารถหาชุดที่
ถูกใจได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ้อ จริงสิ พรุ่งนี้ฉันต้องไปซื้อชุด ห้ามมาสายนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ไม่ได้ลืมนัดใช่มั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้เราต้องไปดูชุดกันค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เรานัดไปดูชุดกันด้วยเหรอ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จริงๆ เลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ต้องถามแล้วค่ะ ออกมาได้แล้ว!
เป็นผู้ใหญ่ไม่ใช่เหรอคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หัวร้อนจริงๆ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มะ... ไม่มีอะไร แล้วครูจะรีบไปนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ คุณครู ฉันจะรอนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู... ฉันได้ชุดมาแล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษนะคะ ฉันไปรับชุดคนเดียวก็ได้แท้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันทำให้คุณครูลำบากจนได้นะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ฉันจะตอบแทนให้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันอะไรกันคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เชือกนี้มัน...? ดูเหมือนกับ... ริบบิ้นเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อ้อ อันนั้นน่ะเหรอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ชุดชั้นในเหรอ...? ไม่สิ ดูยังไงก็เป็นเชือกอยู่ดีไม่ใช่เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อันนี้คุณครู...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ชุดนั้นน่ะ อาโกะ ครูซื้อให้ก็จริง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แปลว่าจะให้ฉันใส่ชุดชั้นในโป๊ๆ เหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะปกติฉันเป็นคนอวดดี ก็เลยจะลงโทษด้วยการให้ใส่อะไรแบบนี้เหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเจตนาแบบนั้นเหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่นะ ไม่ใช่สักหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คิดว่าฉันจะยอมทำตามให้งั้นเหรอคะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่อยากเชื่อเลย...
ต่อให้จะไม่รู้จักอายก็ต้องมีขีดจำกัดสิ ฉันจะเอาชุดนี้ไปคืนค่ะ! เอาไปคืนเลย!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
รู้ไว้ด้วยนะคะ!
ฉันจะเอาชุดนี้ไปคืนค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เฮ้อ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ใกล้จะถึงปาร์ตี้แล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ว่าฉันก็เตรียมพร้อมทุกอย่างไว้แล้ว
ละค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฮุฮุ สงครามนั้นก็จะจบลงด้วยชัยชนะ
ของฉันค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ความตั้งใจแรงกล้าจังเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อืม แต่ฉันก็คิดว่าเราจำเป็นต้องเตรียม
การให้รอบคอบกว่านี้ก่อนการต่อสู้ที่
สำคัญนี้ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะมันไม่ควรจะมีข้อผิดพลาดแม้แต่นิดเดียวค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็ต้องไปฝึกซ้อมค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ฝึกซ้อมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ออกมาเจอกันที่นี่ภายในเวลา
นัดนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มาฝึกพิเศษกับฉันค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ขอบคุณมากเลยค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อาโกะเองก็ทำได้ดีมากนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ... คุณครูคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ของขวัญที่ให้มา... ฉันจะรักษาไว้เป็นอย่างดีเลยค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รู้ไว้แบบนั้นแล้วกันค่ะ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒錯，不知該說囂張還是無法原諒……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果要挑起事端，身為風紀委員會的行政官當然不能逃避

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不，這樣反而正好，就趁這個機會擊潰他們！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這是讓他們從底層望向高高在上的我，重新審視自己位置的機會。對那些傢伙來說也會是一劑良藥吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不能遲到哦！這可是戰爭！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 好像我之前都不冷靜一樣？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 才沒有，我超冷靜的好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 先不說這個了……我決定要選哪件禮服了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我決定挑老師幫我選的那件。因為賣這件禮服的地方只有這裡，所以才聯絡老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 幸好對方表示現在還能訂做

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 能找到喜歡的款式真是太好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，對了。明天要去領禮服，老師可不能遲到，知道嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，您該不會忘記了吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天是要去領禮服的日子

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 別拖拖拉拉的了，快過來！您不是大人嗎！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒，沒什麼……我會準時到的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真不好意思，我明明該自己去的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 繩子……？這類似……蝴蝶結的東西……是什麼？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這是內衣……？不，這只是您再三強調是內衣的繩子而已吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒錯，亞子。那是我買給你的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 也就是說，老師要我穿這麼色的內衣嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為我平常太囂張，所以想罰我穿這個嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真是太誇張了……脫序也要有個限度，我要退貨！退貨！！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我已經做好萬全的準備

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵。這樣那場戰爭就會順利以我的勝利落幕吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，不過我認為在這麼重要的戰鬥之前，必須做更周密的準備

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師。請在約定時間前到這裡來

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 您送的禮物……我會好好珍惜的
